name: Center Ring
flavor: You do not want the spotlight. You have never wanted the spotlight. But you know exactly where to point it, and the whole room follows your hand.
description: You throw the spotlight onto a pairing of your choosing. Choose one creature you can see within range and one other creature you can see — the one you want it dealing with. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}}. On a failure, until the start of your next turn it must direct its next attack, trick, or other harmful single-target effect at the creature you named, if that creature is a legal target for it; if it is not, the effect simply lapses for that action. **This changes who it aims at, nothing else:** it makes its own attack roll against the named creature's AC as normal, and can miss, exactly as with the Puppeteer's Turncoat Strings. You cannot name yourself — the Jester books the act, he does not headline it.
narration: You gesture the way a ringmaster gestures, and the thing turns to look at whoever is standing at the end of your arm. It was going to hurt somebody anyway. Now it is going to hurt the one wearing armour.
sheetSummary: Action, 60 ft, cooldown 3. Name a target and another creature you can see. Wisdom save vs {{trick save DC|8 + proficiency bonus + your trick ability modifier}} or, until the start of your next turn, it must aim its next attack or harmful single-target effect at the creature you named, if legal. It still rolls its attack against that creature's AC as normal and can miss. You can never name yourself.
